flashcard_questions.q: A genre of popular music that is commercially produced, usually with catchy melodies, simple structures and broad appeal.
Instruments that produce sound naturally without electrical amplification, such as piano, acoustic guitar and drum kit.
Instruments that require electricity to produce or amplify sound, such as synthesisers, drum machines and electric guitars.

flashcard_questions.a: The way a piece of music is organised into sections, such as verse, chorus and bridge.
A song structure that alternates between verses (A sections) and choruses (B sections), following an ABAB pattern.
